decisions.reason: Organic sliced ham is a close extension of the firm’s established meat-processing and slicing capabilities, so a large experienced producer can learn from early sales and refine it rather than withdraw it quickly.
Organic sliced cured smoked pork also builds strongly on existing know-how, though its narrower demand than standard ham makes rationalisation somewhat more likely if volume disappoints.
Organic pepper-coated salami fits very closely with core salami expertise and seasoning knowledge, giving the firm strong absorptive capacity to improve and sustain the product.

The beef in teriyaki aspic deli specialty is a more exotic niche item for the service counter, so despite related meat knowledge the firm is less likely to see enough scalable demand to justify keeping it.

Fennel-flavoured sliced salami remains a related flavour variation within the firm’s cured-meat base, and the dedicated presentation suggests enough internal commitment to keep testing and learning from the market.

Liver pâté with veal is still well within the firm’s established processing knowledge, and a large incumbent can use its product-development and customer feedback channels to adjust the premium recipe before dropping it.
